title: Base-flat complexes are tor-independent under pullback
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let g:T\to S be a morphism, let X be an S-scheme, and let g':X_T\to X be the projection [def-pc-base-change]. If G^\bullet is a bounded-above complex of quasi-coherent \mathcal O_X-modules whose terms are flat over S, then for every x'\in X_T, with x=g'(x'), s the image of x in S, and t the image of x' in T, and every i\in\mathbf Z, the canonical stalkwise base-change map H^i(G_x^\bullet\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{T,t})\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{T,t}}\mathcal O_{X_T,x'}\to H^i(((g')^*G^\bullet)_{x'}) is an isomorphism [def-pc-derived-pullback].
